Done. All three functions are implemented and exported:

- **`clamp(n, min, max)`** in src/num.js returns n clamped to the range [min, max]
- **`formatBytes(n)`** in src/util.js formats byte counts with one decimal place (B, KB, MB, GB)
- **`slugify(title)`** in src/text.js converts titles to lowercase dashed slugs, stripping non-alphanumeric characters

All changes noted in CHANGELOG.md under [Unreleased].
